Three signals agree (drawing, supplier, physical goods). The superseded 2026-09-10 tv-direction entry for 926872 is removed in this same change so one address carries one answer. ALREADY WRITTEN BY STAFF before this entry existed: SO amendment HC-SO-013497/A1 ('ERP convert wrong item code', SO_APPROVED 2026-09-14 01:09 UTC) and its PO follow-up HC-PO-2609-064/A1 (APPROVED 01:19, PO revision 2).
